lines.text: INT. UNIVERSITY LIBRARY STUDY ROOM - NIGHT
Laptops, empty energy drink cans. PRIYA (19) stares at a whiteboard covered in equations. MARCUS (19) bursts in, phone in hand.

lines.speaker: MARCUS
lines.text: You didn't answer the group chat.

lines.speaker: MARCUS
lines.text: Forty messages, Priya. They're saying you're dropping the project.

lines.speaker: PRIYA
lines.text: I'm not dropping the project. I'm dropping you guys.
He sets his phone face down on the table.
A long beat. Priya finally turns to face him.

lines.speaker: PRIYA
lines.text: You told them it was your idea.
His phone buzzes. He doesn't look at it.
